name: Battleboar Snout
summary: Young tauren hunters gather Battleboar Snouts near Red Cloud Mesa as the Bristleback press into their hunting grounds. The snouts also go into stews for the young in Camp Narache.

sections.title: Trophies and Provisions
sections.body: Bristleback quilboar train battleboars in Brambleblade Ravine, in the shadow of Red Cloud Mesa, to probe tauren hunting grounds. Grull Hawkwind sends young braves to push back against the encroachment. A snout proves that a battleboar has been brought down. The tauren use the snouts with cuts of flank in rich stews for their young.

faq.q: What are Battleboar Snouts used for?
aliases: what does grull do with snouts
faq.answer: Grull Hawkwind asks young hunters in Camp Narache to gather Battleboar Snouts and meat flanks. The snouts prove that threatening boars have been slain, and the tauren cook them into stew for the tribe's youth.

faq.q: Where do these snouts come from?
faq.answer: Battleboar Snouts come from Battleboars and Bristleback Battleboars near the fringes of Red Cloud Mesa and throughout Brambleblade Ravine to the east.

faq.q: Why are the battleboars encroaching on tauren land?
faq.answer: Hostile Bristleback quilboar have trained the battleboars to be exceptionally vicious. The boars push out from Brambleblade Ravine into traditional tauren hunting grounds.

angles.text: As a tauren, gathering the snout with the meat honors the Earthmother's balance. It curbs an encroaching predator and provides food for the young in Camp Narache.
As a cook, you can boil tough cuts like snouts slowly over a fire for tribal campfire stews.
